g.text: What both acknowledge becomes the official truth.
दो फोन · एक साझा हिसाब · अगस्त 2026
झाड़ू, पोंछा, बर्तन एवं दोनों समय का खाना
मालिक द्वारा दर्ज · सहायक समीक्षा शेष
* Recorded by employer. Holds ₹0 on Hisaab.
क्या 13 अगस्त का यह काम सही है?
* Today's ₹500 is pending. Tap "Sahi Hai" to add.
जो दोनों मानें, वही हिसाब — न एक रुपया कम, न ज्यादा।
Two separate memories create contradictory balances.
"अकेला हिसाब हर महीने बहस में बदल जाता है।"
A pencil tick mark cannot distinguish a full day from a half day. When dates blur, memory becomes an argument.
"Did she come in the morning or evening?"
₹1,000 cash given in a hurry at the door. No slip. No timestamp. By the 31st, one remembers ₹1,000; the other ₹500.
"Was it for school fees or bonus?"
Every day's work and every advance is confirmed tonight on mobile. Only mutually agreed entries exist in the official hisaab.
Sharma Ji logs attendance. Under the mutual rule, this entry is held in quarantine. It carries ₹0.00 until acknowledged.
"जब तक सुनीता दीदी 'सही है' नहीं दबाएंगी, यह रकम हिसाब में नहीं जुड़ेगी।"
"कमाई, पेसगी और पक्का बकाया — सब स्पष्ट।"
Household work is real work. It deserves the mutual dignity of a shared, transparent digital record.
Two phones. One record. Complete mutual peace.
Dono ka record, ek hi hisaab.
